description: Round-seven held-out synthetic meetings for the variant robustness eval, written blind to earlier rounds and to the Rust implementation. Settings are an allotment society, a veterinary clinic, a food bank, a brewery, a theatre company and a volunteer fire station. They cover conditional and negated commitments with varied cues (if, only if, unless, until, provided that, as long as, once, after, weather permitting), negated group decisions, two commitments by one speaker in one sentence, date corrections within a sentence and by another speaker (with and without owner confirmation), an ownership correction combined with a date correction, quantities restated mid-meeting, prices and counts with restrictions and at-least thresholds, multi-word dates, weekdays and bare days, spoken headings, supplier and product names that look like people or places, questions and ideas that are not tasks, completed statuses and reported speech. Further phenomena: a condition stated in the next sentence, a correction that targets an earlier commitment rather than the nearest one, a retracted commitment, a commitment restated later with the same date, a condition shared by two commitments, a commitment made in answer to a request, a commitment reported by a third person, the same verb with two objects and two dates, deadline phrases such as end of the month and next Friday, a cancelled event with a date that is no one's deadline, and a quantity corrected in a status report. Not used by Rust tests.

segments.speaker: Wilhelmina
segments.text: Water and fencing. We agreed to dig the standpipe trench on the 14th of November, provided that the council signs the lease extension.

segments.speaker: Dougal
segments.text: I'll order the pipe by Thursday, no, Friday, and I'll collect the fittings from Hartley Hire on the 12th of November.

segments.speaker: Prisha
segments.text: Seed potatoes. We need 3 sacks of first earlies. Actually, make that 4, because the new plots at the top end want some too.

segments.speaker: Osric
segments.text: Plot rents are 36 pounds a year, or 18 pounds for pensioners. The rent letters were posted last week.

segments.speaker: Wilhelmina
segments.text: Provided that the grant comes through, Osric will buy the fence posts and Prisha will hire the post driver.

segments.speaker: Dougal
segments.text: I'll phone the water board about the meter on Monday. Scratch that, Osric phoned them yesterday, so I won't phone them.

segments.speaker: Prisha
segments.text: The AGM hall was booked last month. Wilhelmina, could you send the AGM notice to all plot holders by the end of the month?

segments.speaker: Wilhelmina
segments.text: Yes, I'll send the notice by the end of the month.

segments.speaker: Osric
segments.text: We decided not to allow bonfires on site this winter. Somebody should look into a shed for the tool library, but that's only an idea.

segments.speaker: Dougal
segments.text: Hartley Hire said the post driver is already booked out this week.

segments.speaker: Ingrid
segments.text: Rota. We agreed to open the Saturday surgery on November the 2nd, provided that at least 2 nurses are on shift.

segments.speaker: Cormac
segments.text: I'll order the dental scaler from Whitlock on Tuesday, or rather Wednesday, and I'll book the locum for the 15th.

segments.speaker: Zofia
segments.text: Stock check: I'll count the vaccine fridge on the 12th.

segments.speaker: Ingrid
segments.text: Sorry, Zofia, make it the 21st. The auditors arrive on the 12th.

segments.speaker: Zofia
segments.text: Fine, the 21st works for me.

segments.speaker: Lachlan
segments.text: I won't switch the phones to the answering service until Juniper, the new booking software, is live.

segments.speaker: Ingrid
segments.text: Boarding: the kennel repairs are already done. Lachlan, you'll update the website with the new opening hours by Monday.

segments.speaker: Cormac
segments.text: Actually, Zofia has the login, so Zofia should do that instead. And make it Tuesday, the website is down for maintenance on Monday.

segments.speaker: Zofia
segments.text: Okay, I'll update the website by Tuesday.

segments.speaker: Ingrid
segments.text: We decided not to offer Sunday walk-in clinics this winter. Whitlock, the wholesaler, told me the new vaccine batch was delayed.

segments.speaker: Cormac
segments.text: Whitlock quoted 24 pounds a box for dewormer, or 19 pounds a box on orders of 10 boxes or more. Could we ever stock a cheaper dog food? That's a question, not a task.

segments.speaker: Nadia
segments.text: Deliveries. We decided to move the Tuesday pick-up to the Dunmore depot on the 7th of January, as long as the van passes its inspection.

segments.speaker: Obadiah
segments.text: I'll book the van inspection for the 3rd, sorry, I mean the 5th, and I'll email Dunmore the new pick-up time.

segments.speaker: Pearl
segments.text: Volunteers: we need 6 volunteers for the Saturday sort. Actually, make that 8, and at least 2 of them must be able to lift pallets.

segments.speaker: Quentin
segments.text: Vouchers are worth 10 pounds per household, or 20 pounds for households of five or more.

segments.speaker: Nadia
segments.text: Quentin, you'll collect the shelving from Marlow Storage by Friday.

segments.speaker: Obadiah
segments.text: Quentin can't, he's away all week. Pearl should do it, and she'd better make it next Friday.

segments.speaker: Pearl
segments.text: Okay, I'll collect the shelving by next Friday.

segments.speaker: Quentin
segments.text: I'll send the committee the lease summary after the trustees confirm the rent, and I won't sign the lease until the auditor has seen it.

segments.speaker: Nadia
segments.text: Just a thought: could we ask the school about a collection box? That's an idea, not a task. The freezer order was approved last week.

segments.speaker: Obadiah
segments.text: Pearl told me the council has already renewed our food hygiene certificate. We agreed not to hand out vouchers on Saturdays.

segments.speaker: Imogen
segments.text: Budget. The tank upgrade costs 18,500 pounds, and we've set aside 12,000 pounds so far.

segments.speaker: Imogen
segments.text: We agreed to order the new fermenter on the 14th of November, only if the bank approves the loan.

segments.speaker: Basil
segments.text: I'll collect the hops from Harlan on the 3rd, and I'll write up the new recipe by the end of the month.

segments.speaker: Tamar
segments.text: Basil, the hops are ready on the 10th, not the 3rd.

segments.speaker: Ulric
segments.text: Label design: Wren Print quoted 45 pence a label, or 30 pence a label for runs of at least 5,000.

segments.speaker: Imogen
segments.text: I'll sign off the label proof on Monday. That's only if the colours match the sample Ulric showed us.

segments.speaker: Tamar
segments.text: I'll book the Brightside cleaning crew on October the ninth unless Imogen finds a cheaper firm.

segments.speaker: Imogen
segments.text: Basil, just to confirm, you're writing up the recipe by the end of the month?

segments.speaker: Basil
segments.text: Yes, I'll write up the recipe by the end of the month.

segments.speaker: Ulric
segments.text: We decided not to brew the winter stout this year. The summer ale batch was bottled last week.

segments.speaker: Tamar
segments.text: Harlan told me the crystal malt is sold out until January. And could we ever open a taproom? That's an idea, not a task.

segments.speaker: Cordelia
segments.text: Venue. We agreed to hold the dress rehearsal at Stanton Hall on the 18th of March once the heating is fixed.

segments.speaker: Hettie
segments.text: I'll print the posters on Monday and the programmes on Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Ambrose
segments.text: Props. I'll collect the costume rails from Marlowe on the 20th, or rather the 22nd, if the minibus is free.

segments.speaker: Wilfred
segments.text: Tickets: 14 pounds, or 9 pounds for senior citizens.

segments.speaker: Cordelia
segments.text: We need 5 ushers for opening night. Actually, make that 6, and at least 2 of them should be first aiders.

segments.speaker: Hettie
segments.text: Ambrose told me he'll build the second staircase by the 5th of March.

segments.speaker: Wilfred
segments.text: Lighting: Rosalind, the new lighting desk, was delivered on Tuesday. I won't rig the desk until the electrician has signed off the power supply.

segments.speaker: Cordelia
segments.text: Raffle. Hettie, you'll phone the licensing office about the raffle permit by Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Ambrose
segments.text: Not Hettie, Wilfred should do that, and make it Thursday, the office is shut on Wednesdays.

segments.speaker: Wilfred
segments.text: Fine, I'll phone the licensing office on Thursday.

segments.speaker: Cordelia
segments.text: We decided not to tour the show this summer. And should we think about an understudy for the lead? That's a question, not a task.

segments.speaker: Gideon
segments.text: Equipment. We decided to buy the replacement hose from Carver on the 28th, after the parish council releases the grant.

segments.speaker: Marisol
segments.text: I'll test the pump on the 12th, and I'll wash the engines on Saturday, weather permitting.

segments.speaker: Gideon
segments.text: Not the 12th, the 19th. The pump bay is being repainted until the 15th.

segments.speaker: Marisol
segments.text: Right, the 19th then.

segments.speaker: Phineas
segments.text: Recruitment: we need 8 new volunteers, and at least 3 of them must hold a driving licence.

segments.speaker: Delphine
segments.text: I won't sign off any recruit until they've done at least 12 hours of drills.

segments.speaker: Gideon
segments.text: Communications. We have 12 pagers working. Sorry, 13, Phineas fixed one this morning.

segments.speaker: Phineas
segments.text: Rowan, the radio maker, quoted 90 pounds a handset, or 70 pounds a handset for orders of at least 5.

segments.speaker: Delphine
segments.text: Ottoline from the county told me the training budget was approved last week. The ladder drill planned for the 3rd has been cancelled.

segments.speaker: Gideon
segments.text: I'll email the county about the budget on October the ninth, unless Ottoline calls me first.

segments.speaker: Phineas
segments.text: We agreed not to hold the open day this year. Could we run a school visit instead? That's a question, not a task.
